messages:
Sam: quick thread - we need an explainability-first fallback mode. operators and customers repeatedly ask 'why' when traffic is rerouted. this should cover audit, billing, and a tiny UI sketch.
Priya: totally. primary asks: compact one-line audit rows for exports, sampled full traces, and an NL "why" blurb for legal. sampling must be low by default.
Zoe: for billing: every routed request must emit attribution: orig_route, final_route, tokens. these fields go into billing export so invoices match observed traffic. also add a cost_delta_est in the daily preview.
Ben: replayability is critical. include a replay_seed + signal_snapshot in each compact row so SREs can deterministically replay decisions locally. even compact rows should have that.
Sam: UX idea: rollout card shows a tiny status pill (auto | manual | frozen), current routed_pct, and a small "why" button. clicking why opens a sampled NL row and links to the full trace if available.
Priya: sampling proposal: compact_audit 0.05% default, full_trace 0.001% default, with an anomaly boost multiplier (x50) when primary signal jumps > 2x. retention configurable per-org.
Zoe: audit CSV schema (one-line) we want mandatory for compact rows: ts, rollout_id, decision_type, routed_pct, mode, reason_code, signal_snapshot, replay_seed, orig_route, final_route, tokens, operator_id_opt. keep field order stable for downstream parsers.
Ben: NL blurb example for sampled rows: "Auto-routed 12% to alt-model due to error_rate=0.14 (above 0.05) + latency_p95=820ms." generate only for sampled rows to save CPU.
Priya: generator should be serverless, cached, and attachable on-demand for legal exports. make NL optional in API export.
Sam: operator controls: big Freeze button (zero-click), manual_override endpoint (/v1/rollouts/{id}/override), and a small preview modal that shows projected monthly token delta for median and p95 before enabling a policy.
Zoe: cost preview algo: take 24h observed traffic, apply routed_pct, compute token delta under median/worst-case distributions, surface both absolute and percent change. include warning if projected spend exceeds customer tier budget.
Ben: telemetry & logging notes: every sampled decision must record a compact reason_code set (enum) and a confidence float. full traces include raw signals + model outputs (scrub PII). add audit_retention_days default 90.
Priya: API sketch (compact) to include in RFC: ```yaml
id: r_explain_01
mode: explainable_auto_fallback
sampling:
  compact_audit_rate: 0.0005
  full_trace_rate: 0.00001
  anomaly_boost: 50
guards:
  hard_escalate_window: 30s
  hard_escalate_threshold: 0.25
telemetry:
  audit_retention_days: 90
  nl_blurb_enabled: false
operator_controls:
  freeze_route: true
  manual_override_api: /v1/rollouts/r_explain_01/override
```
Sam: runbook: when a customer complains, ops should 1) fetch compact CSV rows for timeframe, 2) if needed, fetch full traces for sampled ids, 3) use replay_seed + snapshot to reproduce decisions, 4) generate NL blurb for legal if requested. add these steps to the oncall playbook.
Zoe: infra action items: 1) ensure billing export includes attribution fields, 2) add replay endpoint to admin API, 3) metric catalog entries for any new signals used. I'll file tickets.
deploy-bot: will announce when RFC lands and will post a weekly digest of explainable rollouts to #eng-platform (top reason codes + cost delta). :robot_face:
Priya: next step I'll draft the RFC with API + CSV schema + UI mock. Sam, Ben, Zoe please review. thanks all.
